utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I can check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira—that’d be helpful. Let me know what you find, and we can keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and see what I can learn while I’m out. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick heads-up: I can help sort the repair drive list and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — please sort the list and flag anything still broken.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it looks like it’s happening, but I’d still wait to spread the word until we know the exact time and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll hold off until we have the exact time and drop-off info.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and make a quick list of what’s missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, Cleo—thank you. I’ll grab the tools and whatever else I can find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, sure — I think it’s the repair drive for the neighborhood stuff, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details. I can check and send you the exact info.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please send the exact details when you have them, and I’ll double-check everything before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by a little late and still help out. Just tell me what’s left when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works great — I’ll text you the latest list before you head over. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out for your text and head over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a few screwdrivers? We’ll start with the loose cabinet door and see what else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few screwdrivers. See you there, and we’ll get that cabinet door sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where things are being dropped off for the repair drive. If you tell me the locations, I’ll make a neat list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Opal—thank you. I’ll send you the drop-off locations as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping off all sorts of useful stuff. If you want, I can tell you what they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great—what are they still short on? I can pass it along to a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still really short on basic tools and a few small appliances—things like hammers, screwdrivers, lamps, and toasters are in demand. If you can spread the word, that’d help a lot!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend, or did the timing change?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend, or did the timing change?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what they still need. If you’re going, I can tag along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can head over later and ask what they still need, then we can go together if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive plan in order now. If you can, send me the list of needed fixes and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll write up the needed fixes and send them over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Uli — I’ll watch for it and get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need anything specific, I can keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear, Tess. If you spot any spare screwdrivers or a small pry bar, could you set them aside for me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli — I’ll set aside any spare screwdrivers or a small pry bar if I spot them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane — we’re still on track for the repair drive, and I’m checking who can help with the tools and pickup. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I can help with the pickup if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, but what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s for the old places on the block that need fixing up—small repairs, mostly. I’ve been meaning to keep it low-key, but any help would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good to me—I can help with small repairs. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics for the repair drive, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is at the community center parking lot, by the blue donation bins. I’ll send the rest of the basics right over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ve got the location. Send the rest when you can and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive. Want me to share the details with your group too?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please share them — I’d like the details first so I can pass them along accurately.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the update; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help—just tell me what’s needed and I’ll try to get it done.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. Let me know what you hear, and I can bring over any tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and see what folks know. If I hear anything useful, I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great—let’s meet at the community shed at 10, sort donations into tools, parts, and supplies, then we’ll head out together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact drop-off time and what needs fixing so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — I’ll get the exact drop-off time and a list of what needs fixing, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — just send me those details when you have them, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, just a heads-up—the repair drive’s coming together fast. If you want in, I can get you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Count me in, Quinn—send me the details and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Cleo—I’ll send you the details now, and if you’re up for it, maybe bring a tool kit or a few snacks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—just tell me when the repair drive is and what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — once you have the date and time, I can work around pickup and drop-off and help make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—mostly volunteers for check-in, sorting supplies, and a few folks to help with pickups and drop-offs. If you’d like, I can put your name down for one of those.
